# Pull Request Template

## Description
Please provide a brief description of the changes made in this pull request.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Test addition

## Related Issues
Link any related issues that this PR addresses or closes:

- Fixes #
- Closes #
- Related to #

## Motivation and Context
Why is this change needed? What problem does it solve?

## How Has This Been Tested?
Please describe in detail how you tested your changes. Include details of:

- Test environment (OS, Docker versions, etc.)
- Test cases covered
- Edge cases tested
- Manual testing performed

## Checklist
Please go through all the items below and check the boxes for items you have completed:

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have followed the project's coding standards
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published
- [ ] I have verified that my changes don't break any existing functionality
- [ ] I have documented my changes where necessary

## Breaking Changes
If this PR contains breaking changes, please describe:

- What the breaking change is
- Why this change is necessary
- How users should migrate their code
- Related migration guides or documentation

## Screenshots or Videos
If your changes affect the UI, please include screenshots or screen recordings:

Add any other context or screenshots about the pull request here.

## For Maintainers

### Review Criteria
When reviewing this PR, please consider:

- [ ] Correctness - Does it work as intended?
- [ ] Design - Is it well-structured and maintainable?
- [ ] Tests - Are there adequate tests?
- [ ] Documentation - Is it properly documented?
- [ ] Performance - Are there performance concerns?
- [ ] Security - Are there security implications?

### Automated Checks
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint` / `composer lint`)
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] TypeScript types are correct
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities detected
